en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, modernist multi‑storey building along a street, likely a socialist‑era public clinic. The facade has repetitive vertical window bays and a glassy ground floor. People walk on the sidewalk and a small car is parked on the street, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century scene. The back of the postcard has multilingual printing describing the building as the ambulatory clinic of the trade unions in Pécs, and attribution to photographer Ripely Imre.
